description: Exposed Dockerfile revealing complete Docker container configuration. Shows base image, dependencies, user configuration, and Apache setup. Indicates this is a containerized PHP/Apache application listening on port 8081.
notes: CRITICAL FINDINGS: (1) Dockerfile is publicly accessible, revealing complete infrastructure setup. (2) Base image: php:8.1-apache. (3) SQLite database stored in /var/db. (4) Application directory: /var/www/html. (5) Runs under 'appuser' (UID 1000) for initial setup, then switches to 'root' for final commands and 'www-data' for web service. (6) Uses composer for dependency management. (7) Apache configured via wwwconf/app_conf.conf. (8) Port explicitly set to 8081.
